faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT(ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.E./M.Tech/ M.S/ Integrated M.Tech. or B.E/B.Tech. in specific disciplines, or an M.Sc./ M.Sc.Tech degree, along with a valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualification.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA, as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which disciplines are considered for the B.E/B.Tech qualification?
faq.answer: The eligible disciplines for B.E/B.Tech are Metallurgical, Chemical, Mineral, Mining, Environmental, or Mechanical engineering, along with their related fields.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The link to the official notification PDF can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.
